newsitem.title: USA: Perkin-Elmer adds screening assay lab.
newsitem.headline: Perkin-Elmer adds screening assay lab.

text.p: Tropix, a subsidiary of Perkin-Elmer Corp, said Tuesday that it has substantially expanded its line of drug discovery products and services by establishing an additional laboratory to develop custom screening assays for the pharmaceutical industry.
Tropix, which has developed proprietary drug discovery assay systems on a limited basis, said it now makes this service available to the worldwide pharmaceutical industry.
The company said will help its customers enhance their in-house drug discovery by incorporating its state-of-the-art proprietary chemiluminescent technology into highly sensitive assay systems.
